who: Duna Kaufmann, a human officer of the Dawn empire's eastern army and adjutant to the marshal at the east gate of the white-stone wall, forty-five, a merchant's daughter from a warehouse by the capital's docks who counted the goods as a child: not tall, compact and wiry. Short dark russet-copper hair with a few white hairs at the temples, blue-green eyes, a brisk, sharp face. Once a cavalrywoman who rode in wedge charges, she left the saddle with a bad left knee that aches before rain. She counts everything: people, coins, candles, carts. A brisk, exact, dry-humoured air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about forty-five, brisk and sharp: medium almond eyes of blue-green with fine lines at the corners; straight brows; a firm, thin mouth with a dry humour in it. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 160 cm, compact and wiry, her weight kept off the left knee.
palette: Dawn white and slate blue, russet copper, ink black, a little brass
casual: Her adjutant's uniform of the eastern army: a fitted slate-blue officer's coat with a stand collar and brass buttons, a small gold kite badge on the left breast, a white shoulder cord, a satchel of ledgers and a pencil case at her hip, a cavalry sabre on a slim belt, dark trousers and riding boots. She holds a small ledger open and a pencil, counting, a brisk, dry look.
private: In her quarters in the signal tower: a plain cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark wool vest, dark trousers and soft boots. She holds a small money box and counts coins into her palm. A tired, wry look.
battle: On the signal tower on the night of the evacuation, in an eastern-army officer's field harness: a fitted cuirass of white steel with a narrow gold rim over the slate-blue stand-collar coat, the gold kite engraved on the breast and a line of tally runes beneath it; steel tassets and a cavalry-pattern knee guard strapped over her bad left knee, steel vambraces, a blue cloth band on the left arm with a cast war badge pinned beside it, a brass field horn on a cord. She grips the cavalry sabre at her side in one hand and holds the open ledger up in the other, calling out a number, the tally runes on her cuirass flickering with each count. A fierce, exact look.
formal: At a Dawn ceremony: a short white and gold dress tunic-coat with a gold kite embroidered on the left breast and gold edging, open at the throat over a slate-blue waistcoat, a slate-blue sash, a cavalry medal ribbon, white gloves, the sabre at her hip, a thin line of tally runes that lights in turn along the sash. She stands very upright, a composed, slightly impatient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes looking at the viewer sharply, a pencil pointing as if counting heads, the open ledger near her chin. Cold blue night light from one side and the warm glow of a signal fire from the other. Foreground blur: a line of cart lanterns, candle flames and the pages of a ledger. She wears the slate-blue officer's coat with the gold kite badge.
battle_old: On the signal tower on the night of the evacuation: a steel cuirass engraved with a gold kite and a line of tally runes over the slate-blue coat, leather bracers, a brass field horn on a cord. She grips the cavalry sabre at her side in one hand and holds the open ledger up in the other, calling out a number, the runes on her cuirass flickering with each count. A fierce, exact look.

name: 路德维希·施莱伯
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:4338
who: Ludwig Schreiber, a human of the Dawn empire and commander of the east slope of the long wall's middle reach, fifty-five, from three generations of copyists in the capital's scribes' offices, who still wants everything written down and stamped: of middle height, spare and upright. Iron-grey hair cropped very short, deep blue eyes, a lined, stern face. The forefinger and middle finger of his right hand are stained blue-black with ink that will not wash off. A dry, strict, scrupulously fair air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's face of about fifty-five, NOT young: narrow deep blue almond eyes with deep lines at the corners and across the brow; short iron-grey brows; a straight nose; a thin, strict mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: about 178 cm, spare and upright.
palette: Dawn slate blue and white, iron grey, ink blue-black, a little gold
casual: His commander's uniform: a long slate-blue officer's coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and narrow gold edging, a small gold kite badge at the collar, a leather document case and the east slope seal on a chain at his belt, dark trousers and polished boots, a plain officer's sword. He holds a sheet of paper and a pen in his ink-stained fingers, a strict, measuring look.
private: At home in the capital: a dark grey wool coat over a white shirt, a knitted scarf, soft shoes. He holds a stack of letters tied with string. A dry, quietly content look.
battle: On the order platform of the sixth tier, in a commander's harness kept for the platform rather than the wall: a fitted steel cuirass with the east slope seal embossed on the breast and a thin gold rim, worn over the long slate-blue stand-collar coat, a steel gorget, thin gold rune lines along the pauldron rims glowing pale, leather gloves, a blue cloth band on the left arm and a small cast war badge at the collar, the document case and the seal on its chain at the belt. He grips the plain officer's sword at his side and holds a written order in his other hand, a faint seal glow on its wax. A stern, unbending look.
formal: At the signing in the gate tunnel: the slate-blue dress coat brushed, a white sash, a short row of medal ribbons, white gloves, the east slope seal hung on its chain. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave, formal look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep blue eyes looking at the viewer over a written order, the ink-stained fingers pressing a seal into hot wax. Cold grey-blue light of an order platform from one side and warm candlelight from the other. Foreground blur: melting sealing wax, a pen and strips of paper. He wears the long slate-blue officer's coat.
art_extra: His very short hair is plain iron grey exactly as in the sprite, on its lit side and its shadow side alike; its shadows a darker neutral grey, NOT blue, violet, lavender or pink; the coloured light only rims its outermost edge.
battle_old: On the order platform of the sixth tier: a steel cuirass with the east slope seal embossed on the breast over the slate-blue coat, a gorget, leather gloves, a small cast war badge at the collar, thin gold rune lines on the pauldron rims. He grips the plain officer's sword at his side and holds a written order in his other hand, a faint seal glow on its wax. A stern, unbending look.

name: 优素福·赤脊
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:4340
who: Yusuf of the Red-Ridge clan, a fire-horn demon-kin veteran of the Azure Flame Horn City legion and commander of the west slope of the long wall's middle reach, about four hundred but looking about thirty-five: tall and solidly built. His left horn broke off at the root in the tide of 858 and is capped with a length of black iron branded with the legion's fire pattern; the right horn is whole. Short auburn hair with two streaks of white that are his mark, not a sign of age, dark gold eyes, a face with no deep lines. A measured, fair air: he speaks in terms of what the agreement says. Two narrow, separate streaks of white run through the auburn hair.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's face of about thirty-five, grave: narrow dark gold almond eyes; straight auburn brows; a strong nose; a firm mouth. Skin with a faint warm red tint and very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm red-brown. Fair skin with only a faint warm red tint, NOT tanned, bronzed or brown; no deep lines at the eyes or mouth.
build: about 188 cm, tall and solidly built.
palette: obsidian black and dark red, auburn, dark gold, black iron
casual: His commander's dress of the legion: a long black wool coat buttoned to the collar over a black leather cuirass, black obsidian-steel pauldrons branded with a ring of fire, a dark red sash, dark trousers and heavy boots; a heavy curved sword at his hip. He stands with one hand resting on the sword hilt, a measured, steady look.
private: In the watch post below the first bell tower: a loose dark red wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a black waistcoat, dark trousers and soft boots. He holds a cup of strong tea. A tired, weathered look.
battle: On the west slope, in a horn-city legion commander's war plate: a black obsidian-steel cuirass and tassets quenched in blue volcanic flame, a faint blue sheen across them, the pauldrons branded with a ring of fire whose grooves glow ember red, a black iron gorget, a mail skirt, black insulated gauntlets, the dark red sash knotted at the hip. He grips the heavy curved sword in both hands, low and forward, a dull heat shimmer along its edge. A grim, unmoving look.
formal: In the gate tunnel for the signing: the legion's black dress cuirass of burnished leather over a dark red doublet with slashed sleeves, dark red facings at shoulders and cuffs, the iron cap on his broken horn polished and etched with a ring of fire, black gloves, a short black cape pinned with an obsidian clasp. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark gold eyes looking at the viewer steadily, the black iron cap on the broken left horn catching a red light. Red light of wall braziers from one side and cold night on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, a branded fire pattern on iron and a sheet of contract paper. He wears the long black coat with the fire-branded pauldrons.
battle_old: On the west slope: the fire-branded pauldrons over the black cuirass, a mail skirt, leather bracers, a black iron gorget. He grips the heavy curved sword in both hands, low and forward. A grim, unmoving look.

name: 葛丽·符文
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_五_黑潮的年月.md:4356
who: Gerri of the Rune branch, a dwarf woman from the forge city who keeps the guild's desk in the stone rooms inside the broken gate on the long wall, seventy-eight but looking just over thirty, as dwarves age slowly: short, sturdy and compact, a grown woman with an adult face, no beard. Copper-orange hair in two thick braids coiled on top of her head, a short stone pencil stuck through them. Moss-green eyes. The top joint of her right little finger is missing, bitten off by the gears of the west sluice gate. At her waist a small hammer and a leather pouch of stone pencils. A brisk, terse, reliable air: she asks your name before anything else.
build: about 130 cm, short, sturdy and compact, broad-shouldered for her size.
palette: copper orange and moss green, slate grey, lamp-oil amber, a little brass
casual: Her clerk's clothes: a sturdy slate-grey wool dress to the shins with the sleeves rolled up, a leather apron with pockets full of tally sticks and string, sturdy boots; at her waist the small hammer and the pouch of stone pencils; a short stone pencil stuck in the coiled braids. She holds a stone pencil over a tally board, a brisk, questioning look.
private: In the back room among the oil jars: a loose undyed wool shirt and the grey dress, a knitted brown shawl, soft boots, the braids still coiled. She holds a lamp-oil measuring cup. A tired, dry look.
battle: The night something knocked under the door of the room below the tunnel: a heavy grey wool coat over the dress, a lantern at her belt. She does not fight: she stands guard holding the small hammer in her right hand and a stone pencil in her left. A grim, steady look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and wary, the feet planted, a grim, steady expression, holding the small hammer in her right hand and a stone pencil in her left; she does not fight.
formal: When the three stone rooms became the guild's wall branch: a clean dark blue wool pinafore dress over a white blouse with a rolled collar, a stone-grey tally-cord sash, a small bronze guild emblem on a cord, a row of tiny stone beads in the freshly coiled braids that tick faintly when she moves. She stands very upright with the hands folded on her apron, a grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the moss-green eyes looking up at the viewer, a stone pencil poised over seven small circles scratched into a table edge. Warm lamp-oil light in a stone room from one side. Foreground blur: lamp-oil jars, coils of rope and a small hammer. She wears the leather apron over the slate-grey dress.
battle_old: The night something knocked under the door of the room below the tunnel: a heavy grey wool coat over the dress, a lantern at her belt. She does not fight: she stands guard holding the small hammer in her right hand and a stone pencil in her left. A grim, steady look.
